what: From a manifest to a cohort
title: Get started with biocohort
text: manifest one row per sample. Four columns carry shape study: subject_id, assay, sample_id, role. Every column metadata, either subject (species, genotype, sex, …) sample (fastq_1, fastq_2, lane, …). read_manifest() reads every column text, id like 007 keeps leading zero. Build cohort parsed tables:
code: dir <- tempfile() dir.create(dir) writeLines(   c(     "subject_id,species,genotype,sex,assay,sample_id,role,fastq_1,fastq_2",     "R1,rat,WT,F,wes,T1,tumor,t1_R1.fq.gz,t1_R2.fq.gz",     "R1,rat,WT,F,wes,N1,normal,n1_R1.fq.gz,n1_R2.fq.gz",     "R2,rat,KO,M,wes,T2,tumor,t2_R1.fq.gz,t2_R2.fq.gz",     "R2,rat,KO,M,wes,N2,normal,n2_R1.fq.gz,n2_R2.fq.gz"   ),   file.path(dir, "manifest.csv") )  parsed <- read_manifest(file.path(dir, "manifest.csv")) parsed$subject_tbl #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   subject_id species genotype sex   #>   <chr>      <chr>   <chr>    <chr> #> 1 R1         rat     WT       F     #> 2 R2         rat     KO       M parsed$sample_map #> # A tibble: 4 × 6 #>   subject_id assay sample_id role   fastq_1     fastq_2     #>   <chr>      <chr> <chr>     <chr>  <chr>       <chr>       #> 1 R1         wes   T1        tumor  t1_R1.fq.gz t1_R2.fq.gz #> 2 R1         wes   N1        normal n1_R1.fq.gz n1_R2.fq.gz #> 3 R2         wes   T2        tumor  t2_R1.fq.gz t2_R2.fq.gz #> 4 R2         wes   N2        normal n2_R1.fq.gz n2_R2.fq.gz cohort <- cohort_new(parsed$subject_tbl, parsed$sample_map) cohort #>  #> ── Cohort #> • 2 subjects (2 rat) #> • 4 samples (4 wes) #> ℹ Extra sample columns: fastq_1, fastq_2

text: biocohort enforce sample ID format. Pick one convention project keep . Putting assay role ID makes easier read: Tumor: {assay}_T{subject}, example "wes_T101", "wgs_T001". title: S7 AnalysisSpec class — AnalysisSpec
text: name Character scalar unique analysis name (key registry). assay Character scalar assay label, spelled cohort's sample_map (e.g., "wes", "wgs", "scrna"). Required. level Character scalar granularity analysis produces results. Must one : "subject": one result per subject. "pair": one result per tumor/normal (case/control) pair, derived sample_pairs() cohort's sample_map. "cohort": single result whole cohort. Required. format Character scalar file format (e.g., "rds", "tsv", "txt"). Optional. analysis_spec_new() fills path_template extension. NA unknown. description Character scalar human-readable description analysis. Optional, defaults NA. path_template Character scalar templated path analysis output. Supports substitution tokens: {root} (root_key), {subject_id}, pair tokens {tumor_sample_id}, {normal_sample_id}, {pair_id} (latter three supplied sample_pairs() level = "pair"). Optional, defaults NA. root_key Character scalar key cohort@paths list use {root} template value (e.g., "msi_root", "sig_root", "wes_root"). Optional, defaults NA. reader Character scalar function name read files matching spec (e.g., "readr::read_tsv", "read.csv"). Optional. analysis_spec_new() fills format. NA unknown. key_cols Character vector column names must present loaded analysis table. load_analysis() checks reading. Optional. analysis_spec_new() fills level. feature_type Optional character scalar declaring analysis's features translate across species translate(): "interval" (liftover) "gene" (ortholog mapping). Optional, defaults NA. gene_col Optional character scalar naming gene-identifier column feature_type = "gene". Optional, defaults NA. id_type Optional gene identifier type feature_type = "gene": "symbol", "entrez", "ensembl". Optional, defaults NA. tumor_role Character scalar naming sample role tumor (case) side pair. Used level = "pair". Default "tumor". normal_role Character scalar naming sample role normal (control) side pair. Used level = "pair". Default "normal". pair_sep Character scalar placed two sample ids sample_pairs() builds pair_id. Used level = "pair". Default "__".

Defaults empty list. qc tibble recording every cohort_qc() call (columns scope, id, action, reason, previous_status, timestamp). Unlike cache, durable record cleared cohort_filter(). Defaults empty table. derived tibble recording every cohort_derive() call (columns name, , level, cutoffs, n_derived, n_na, timestamp). Durable way qc. Defaults empty table.

text: name Character scalar unique analysis name. Must least 1 character long. Serves key cohort registry. assay Character scalar assay label, spelled cohort's sample_map (e.g., "wes", "wgs", "scrna"). Required. Subject pair units enumerated samples assay. level Character scalar granularity analysis produces results. Must one "subject" (one result per subject), "pair" (one result per tumor/normal pair, see sample_pairs()), "cohort" (single result whole cohort). Required. format Character scalar file format (e.g., "rds", "tsv", "txt"). Optional. Defaults extension path_template, NA template. description Character scalar human-readable description. Optional, defaults NA. path_template Character scalar templated file path. Supports tokens: {root} (root_key), {subject_id}, pair tokens {tumor_sample_id}, {normal_sample_id}, {pair_id} (sample_pairs()). Optional, defaults NA. root_key Character scalar key cohort@paths use {root}. Optional, defaults NA. reader Character scalar reader function name (e.g., "readr::read_tsv", "read.csv"). Optional. Defaults format: "csv" "readr::read_csv", "tsv" "txt" "readr::read_tsv", "rds" "readRDS", "parquet" "arrow::read_parquet". NA format. load_analysis() errors neither spec reader argument names reader. key_cols Character vector column names must present loaded table. Optional. Defaults level: "subject_id" subject, c("subject_id", "pair_id") pair, none cohort. Subject pair specs need least one key column. feature_type Optional character scalar declaring analysis's features translated across species orthologize(). One "interval" (coordinate features, translated liftover) "gene" (gene-level features, translated ortholog mapping). Defaults NA (analysis skipped cohort-level translation). gene_col Optional character scalar naming gene-identifier column, used feature_type = "gene". Defaults NA (treated "gene"). id_type Optional gene identifier type feature_type = "gene": one "symbol", "entrez", "ensembl". Defaults NA (treated "symbol"). tumor_role Character scalar naming sample role tumor (case) side pair. Passed sample_pairs() level = "pair". Default "tumor". normal_role Character scalar naming sample role normal (control) side pair. Passed sample_pairs() level = "pair". Default "normal". pair_sep Character scalar placed two sample ids pair_id. Passed sample_pairs() level = "pair". Default "__".
